description: Declarative limits such as `ge`, `le`, `gt`, `min_length`, `max_length` and `pattern`; each failure has its own error type and appears in the JSON Schema.
A classmethod that checks or transforms one field; `mode="after"` (default) gets the typed value, `mode="before"` the raw input.
`mode="before"` receives the raw input of any type; `mode="after"` receives the instance and runs only if every field is valid.
Optional validator argument: `info.data` holds the fields already validated, `info.field_name` the current one.
From `pydantic_core`: raise it with your own error `type`, a message template and a `ctx` dict.
Error dicts without the rejected values; `include_url` and `include_context` drop the other extras.
